readback.title: Identify authorized staging target and integrator for Haven evidence proof
readback.description:
Agent-created decision request — not human acknowledgement. September 12, 2026.

## Decision or approval requested

Which separate non-production Supabase project and app revision may be used for COL-143 hosted evidence proof, and who is the authorized integrator for preparing that target?

## Authorized decision maker

Brian Lewis identifies or routes this question to the environment owner. The environment owner must establish target authority and the approved integration scope. Assignment here requests that decision; it does not make Brian the deployment operator.

## Context, recommendation, and alternatives

COL-143 source exists, but its September 12 proof attempt stopped before any hosted request: only excluded production project `manfqmasfqppukpobpld` was identified. The target ledger, Auth hook, Storage behavior, and deployed app revision remain unverified. This holds corporate history COL-149 and downstream core release work.

Recommend an existing authorized isolated staging target, if one exists, with synthetic fixtures and the reviewed Finance-first/HFO stack. If none exists, identify an owner and approve a separately scoped staging setup. Do not substitute production or a guessed project; no purchase, resource creation, merge, migration, deployment, or activation is authorized by this decision request.

## Required by

Before COL-143 hosted proof resumes. COL-152 in-app reminder source work can proceed independently.

## Blocked work and sufficient answer

Directly blocks COL-143. Supply attributable owner decision, non-production project ref, authorized integrator, approved source/app revision and scope. Provide access through the normal secret channel, never in this issue. The integrator must separately verify current configuration/ledger before execution. Canonical prior evidence: `Haven Facility Workspace/docs/facility-operations/col143-evidence/hosted-proof/RESULT.md`.

## Outcome record

Pending. Record actual decision maker, date, scope and conditions. This decision cannot close hosted proof, staff acceptance, or Homewood go-live.
